manifest.name: LafazFlow Persistent Whisper Engine Reference Manifest
manifest.purpose: Machine-readable evidence snapshot for M0 of the persistent Whisper engine roadmap.

projects.name: FluidVoice
verified_behavior: Delayed startup model preload after UI appears (preloadASRModel after ~1s sleep).
Readiness single-flight and stop/audio-drain phase measurement in ASRService.
Persistent ready audio provider with separate streaming/final state and real-time-factor logs.
Retained model/session with locked readiness state in WhisperProvider.
Bounded asynchronous audio-resource retirement drain.
projects.usage: Behavior adopted (not copied): startup preload timing, audio-stop drain discipline, final/streaming separation.

projects.name: Handy
verified_behavior: Retained LoadedEngine behind Arc<Mutex<Option<LoadedEngine>>>.
Single-flight model loading and engine lease.
Panic containment (catch_unwind) and engine drop/reload after a panicked engine.
Real-time factor measured as audio_secs / compute_secs.
Recorder drains remaining audio until an end-of-stream sentinel before returning samples.
Exactly-once final pipeline completion and repeated-input protection in the coordinator.
projects.usage: Primary Windows lifecycle and audio-finalization reference.

projects.name: VoiceInk
verified_behavior: Optional delayed launch/wake prewarm (Task.sleep ~3s) with a user toggle.
Shared loaded WhisperContext guarded by single-flight (whisperContext == nil check).
Reuse of an already-loaded matching model context.
Serialized native context access with request-level decode settings.
Recording-time loading and pipeline cleanup boundaries.

projects.name: whisper.cpp
verified_behavior: whisper_init_from_file_with_params_no_state and whisper_init_state (fresh per-request decode state).
whisper_full_params with abort_callback/abort_callback_user_data fields (request cancellation).
whisper_get_timings for per-request timing metadata.
whisper_free_state / whisper_free for per-request and shutdown cleanup.
CUDA backend (GGML_CUDA) and Silero VAD support.
whisper_print_system_info for backend readiness diagnostics.
projects.usage: Native worker build source at the pinned revision; MIT-licensed, compatible with LafazFlow GPLv3.

architecture_decisions.label: Evidence-backed improvement
architecture_decisions.evidence: Handy documents Windows Whisper crashes; a separate worker limits a native failure to the worker. Must pass forced-crash tests proving WPF survival and recovery.

architecture_decisions.label: Evidence-backed improvement
architecture_decisions.evidence: Needed for local process isolation without a network listener. Must pass unauthorized-client and malformed-message tests.

architecture_decisions.label: Evidence-backed improvement
architecture_decisions.evidence: Reference tools measure latency/RTF but do not define LafazFlow's exact recovery rule. Must prove fewer slow runs without restart loops.

native_dependency_decision.choice: LafazFlow-owned native worker calling whisper.cpp C API directly at the pinned revision

rejected_alternatives.reason: Binding versions follow their own cadence rather than the pinned whisper.cpp revision; in-process bindings cannot provide the required crash boundary because a native CUDA failure would terminate the WPF process.

comparison.version_control: Direct worker pins exact whisper.cpp SHA 592feef04a1802b18cbeffd0fd0eb5d02570c2ec.
comparison.cuda: GGML_CUDA build with the same backend as the owner's current CUDA CLI.
comparison.vad_parity: Uses whisper.cpp Silero VAD with identical thresholds.
comparison.packaging: Worker binary and matching runtime DLLs are produced by LafazFlow build scripts beside the CLI.
comparison.crash_boundaries: Worker runs as a separate child process; a native crash can terminate only the worker.

whisper_cpp_revision_decision.evidence_gap_resolved: The worker is pinned to 968eebe7 to match the owner's CUDA CLI source revision exactly (M3 output equivalence: 100/100 normalized). The originally proposed pin 592feef0 was intentionally replaced because parity with the in-use CLI matters more than a different historical SHA; recorded as an explicit roadmap revision decision. No silent replacement of the owner's runtime occurs.

evidence_gaps: Resolved in M3: worker and owner CUDA CLI now share revision 968eebe7; output equivalence 100/100.
Bundled CPU CLI revision is taken from the official whisper-bin-x64.zip release at packaging time; the worker build input is pinned to 968eebe7 for reproducible builds.
